citation: Santos PMC, et al. BMC Sports Sci Med Rehabil 2024;16:193
protocol: Single bout of elbow flexion or knee extension (separate days) at 50% of 1RM; SBP, DBP, HR and stroke volume at baseline, immediately after (T0) and 15 min after (T15)
population: 35 young healthy men, 20-39 y, sedentary or irregularly active
note: Resistance load is absolute in kg (50% 1RM); haemodynamics measured non-invasively; no blood markers.
